title: Plants
parentNote: This unit covers parts of plants, types of plants, what plants need to grow, and their uses. Go for a nature walk to spot different plants!
learnBullets: Know the **parts of a plant** (root, stem, leaf, flower, fruit, seed)
Understand what **plants need** to grow (sunlight, water, air, soil)
Learn about **different types of plants** (trees, shrubs, herbs, climbers, creepers)
Know the **uses of plants** (food, medicine, wood, oxygen)
Understand that plants make their **own food** using sunlight
learnItFirst:
**1. Parts of a Plant**

- **Root** — grows underground; absorbs water and minerals; holds the plant in soil
- **Stem** — carries water from roots to leaves; holds the plant upright
- **Leaf** — makes food for the plant using sunlight (green color from chlorophyll)
- **Flower** — helps the plant make seeds; often colorful and fragrant
- **Fruit** — grows from the flower; contains seeds inside
- **Seed** — can grow into a new plant

---

**2. What Plants Need to Grow**

- **Sunlight** — for making food
- **Water** — for drinking and making food
- **Air** — plants breathe too!
- **Soil** — gives nutrients and holds the plant

---

**3. Types of Plants**

| Type | Description | Examples |
|------|-------------|----------|
| **Trees** | Big, tall, hard wooden stem (trunk) | Mango, Neem, Banyan |
| **Shrubs** | Medium-sized, many stems from the ground | Rose, Hibiscus |
| **Herbs** | Small plants with soft stems | Mint, Tulsi, Coriander |
| **Climbers** | Climb up walls or other plants | Money plant, Pea plant |
| **Creepers** | Spread along the ground | Pumpkin, Watermelon |

---

**4. Uses of Plants**

- **Food** — fruits, vegetables, grains
- **Medicine** — Tulsi, Neem, Aloe vera
- **Wood** — furniture, paper, houses
- **Oxygen** — plants give us fresh air to breathe
- **Shade & Beauty** — gardens, parks

---

questions.content: Which part of the plant is usually underground?
questions.why: Roots grow underground and absorb water from the soil

questions.content: Which part of the plant makes food?
questions.why: Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight

questions.content: Plants need ___ to make food.
questions.why: Plants use sunlight to make their own food

questions.content: A mango tree is an example of a ___.
questions.why: A mango tree is big and tall with a hard wooden trunk — it is a tree

questions.content: What is inside a fruit?
questions.why: Fruits contain seeds inside that can grow into new plants

questions.content: Which plant part holds the plant upright?
questions.why: The stem holds the plant upright and carries water to the leaves

questions.content: Rose plant is an example of a ___.
questions.why: Rose is a medium-sized plant with many stems — it is a shrub

questions.content: Leaves are usually ___ in color.
questions.why: Leaves are green because they contain chlorophyll

questions.content: Which of these is a herb?
questions.why: Mint is a small plant with a soft stem — it is a herb

questions.content: Plants give us ___ to breathe.
questions.why: Plants release oxygen that we breathe in to stay alive

questions.content: Which plant climbs up walls and other supports?
questions.why: Money plant is a climber — it climbs up walls and supports

questions.content: Pumpkin plant spreads along the ground. It is a ___.
questions.why: Plants that spread along the ground are called creepers

questions.content: The root absorbs ___ from the soil.
questions.why: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil for the plant

questions.content: Which of these do plants NOT need to grow?
questions.why: Plants need sunlight, water, and air — not toys!

questions.content: A seed grows into a ___.
questions.why: When a seed gets water, air, and warmth, it grows into a new plant

questions.content: Which part of a plant turns into a fruit?
questions.why: A flower turns into a fruit after pollination

questions.content: We get wood from ___.
questions.why: Trees have hard wooden stems (trunks) that give us wood

questions.content: Carrot is a ___ that we eat.
questions.why: Carrot is a root vegetable that grows underground

questions.content: Which of these is a leaf vegetable?
questions.why: Spinach (palak) is a leafy vegetable — we eat its leaves

questions.content: Tulsi plant is used as ___.
questions.why: Tulsi leaves are used as medicine for cough and cold

questions.content: Which of these plants has a thick, hard stem?
questions.why: Banyan tree has a thick, hard wooden trunk

questions.content: We eat the ___ of a cauliflower plant.
questions.why: Cauliflower is the flower part of the plant that we eat

questions.content: Potato grows under the ground. It is a ___.
questions.why: Potato is an underground stem, not a root

questions.content: Which plant gives us both fruit and shade?
questions.why: Mango tree is big and gives tasty mangoes as well as cool shade

questions.content: Plants that have soft, green stems and live for a short time are called ___.
questions.why: Herbs are small plants with soft, green stems that live for a short time

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These questions are a bit tricky. Think carefully!

questions.content: Ravi planted a bean seed in a dark room. The plant grew but looked pale and weak. Why?
questions.why: Plants need sunlight to make food and stay healthy. Without sunlight, they become pale and weak

questions.content: Ginger grows underground like a carrot. But ginger is a ___.
questions.why: Ginger is an underground stem (like potato), not a root

questions.content: A cactus plant lives in the desert where there is very little water. Its stem is ___ to store water.
questions.why: Cactus has a thick, fleshy stem to store water for dry times in the desert

questions.content: If we cut off all the leaves of a plant, what will happen?

options.B: The plant will not be able to make food
options.C: The plant will get more water

questions.why: Leaves make food for the plant. Without leaves, the plant cannot make food and will die

questions.content: Anita noticed that a plant near the window grew towards the sunlight. This shows that plants ___.
questions.why: Plants grow towards sunlight because they need it to make food. This movement is called phototropism
